functions.name: HermiteSplineInterpolate

Clamps degenerate cases: if the endpoint distance is not greater than 0.0 or a5 is 0.0 it copies a1 verbatim; if a5 is 1.0 it copies a3 verbatim. Otherwise it normalizes both tangents in place, evaluates the four cubic Hermite basis functions in a5, and writes the blended X/Y/Z components (scaled by 0.5) to a6[0..2]. Returns a6. If the distance v10 is not greater than 0.0, or the interpolation parameter a5 equals 0.0, copy the start endpoint: a6 = a1 (three components).
Else if a5 equals 1.0, copy the end endpoint: a6 = a3 (three components).
Normalize the start tangent a2 in place: if its squared norm is greater than 0.0, multiply each component by 1.0 / sqrt(norm).
Normalize the end tangent a4 in place: if its squared norm is greater than 0.0, multiply each component by 1.0 / sqrt(norm).
